Pick which remote button this key is. Resume carries on if paused, or after Stop starts the top of Continue Watching from where you left off. The icon changes to match. Menu buttons (arrows, OK, Back, Home) need a player that accepts remote navigation, like the web player or an app on a TV.

Each control uses its own Player if you pick one, otherwise the Default player. On Automatic, a priority user's player comes first (even paused), then whatever's playing.
